'''Garul''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] working with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], moving refugees from [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] to [[Kaliska]]. He used the alias '''Silver Fur''' while on the job. He was killed by [[Jodo Kast]] and [[Zardra]] sometime between the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in Cloud City, due to a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] that he held with information on the location of Rebel refugees within Cloud City.<ref name="Cloud Cover" />
